Move a canvas, or a folder of them, to a new id.

- `move` renames one canvas. `folder: true` moves the whole directory. If `from` is only a folder, the folder is moved anyway. When a canvas file and a folder share a name, the file is moved unless `folder` is set.
- `match` is a filename glob (`*.canvas.tsx`, `*Test.canvas.tsx`). `*` is the only wildcard. State files move with their canvas.
- Lease every source id and every new id first. CanvasLink targets are left as written.
